title: Environmental Digital Twin
description: Curated subset of the Equinor Volve field dataset prepared for environmental and occupational digital-twin integrity analysis. Includes environmental and petrophysical records, production data, and baseline marine survey data used to demonstrate the ECBT (Environmental & Occupational Core Byte Tools) framework for auditable environmental records, blockchain anchoring, and non-compensatory integrity scoring with metrological uncertainty propagation.

creators.name: Iost, Calvin Stefan
creators.affiliation: Escola Politécnica da Universidade de São Paulo (USP)

notes: The Volve field dataset was originally released by Equinor ASA, ExxonMobil Exploration & Production Norway AS, and Bayerngas Norge AS under the Equinor Open Data Sharing License (based on CC BY 4.0). This curated subset is redistributed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to all three rights holders. CRediT contributor roles: Iost — Conceptualization, Methodology, Software, Formal analysis, Investigation, Data curation, Visualization, Writing – original draft, Writing – review & editing, Project administration; Russo — Supervision, Conceptualization, Methodology (advisor); Sturba — Validation, Methodology (ecbyts system reviewer); Botelho Junior — Supervision (co-advisor). Supporting data for doctoral research at PPGEMP, Escola Politécnica da USP.
